story.title: Pixxel and Sarvam AI to Launch India's First Orbital Data Centre Satellite in 2026
story.summary: Bengaluru-based space tech startup Pixxel is set to launch India's first orbital data centre satellite this year, with Sarvam AI providing the onboard AI backbone for the mission. Pixxel will design, build, launch, and operate the satellite, marking a convergence of India's fast-growing space and AI sectors. The collaboration positions India as one of very few countries attempting to place AI computing capability directly in orbit.
